meta.name: Cover Up
meta.description: Why did appointed officials of the Australian Reserve Bank and its employees break sanctions in Iraq and cosy up to Saddam Hussein through a frontman during the late 1990s, early 2000s and beyond? Why did a former Deputy Governor and other directors hand-picked by the Reserve Bank to safeguard its subsidiary companies from corruption, end up–over a decade–overseeing some of the most corrupt business practices possible? How did they allow millions of dollars to be wired to third parties in foreign countries–including a known arms dealer–in order to win banknote contracts knowingly using bribery and supporting corruption?
